summary: This is a November 2, 2023 blog post by Carly Trigg on the Christmas Tree World website, titled Christmas Spirit Index. It ranks countries and UK cities by how strongly their populations still believe in Santa Claus, using Google search data per 100,000 people. Ireland tops the country list, and Belfast tops the UK city list. The note is cut off partway through the UK city list, so the third-place city and the rest of the list are missing. Website navigation and promotional boilerplate were ignored.
one_line: A 2023 Christmas Tree World blog post ranking countries and UK cities by Google searches about Santa Claus per 100,000 people.
key_facts: The Christmas Spirit Index article was written by Carly Trigg and published on November 02, 2023 by Christmas Tree World.
The ranking was based on Google search data from countries across the globe, as well as in the UK and US.
Ireland ranked first among countries that still believe in Santa, with 1,175 Google searches per 100,000 people.
Ireland had almost double the searches per 100,000 people of any other country in the ranking.
Santa appeared in a famous Christmas edition of the 'Guinness for Strength' advertising campaign, and his image has been etched into the froth on top of a pint of Guinness.
Australia ranked second among countries, with 517 Google searches per 100,000 people.
The note says it would take Santa 34 hours to fly from near the North Pole to Sydney commercially.
The United Kingdom ranked third among countries, with 495 Google searches per 100,000 people, described as just under 500.
Belfast ranked first among UK cities, with 1,412 Google searches per 100,000 people, and is described as the Christmas capital of the UK.
Belfast's Christmas traditions include the festival in City Hall Gardens and its continental Christmas markets.
Leeds ranked second among UK cities, with 822 Google searches per 100,000 people, the second highest in the UK after Belfast.
Leeds is described as the English city with the biggest belief in the magic of Santa and Christmas.
UK children's traditions for Father Christmas include leaving sacks and stockings out for presents and leaving biscuits and a drink for him.
The note is truncated during the UK cities list, so the third-ranked city (beginning 'Manch') is not included.
